description:
Whether you are a seasoned veteran or just rolled your very first character, you have found your home. We are an open, friendly community welcoming any and all players. It doesn't matter if you want to chat all day, quietly grind, min-max your stats, or just check in for five minutes on your lunch break—everyone has a place in our ranks.


Our goal is simple: grow together, share knowledge, and enjoy the game at our own pace.


🛡️ Getting Started: Guild Tips for New Players
Always Be Idling: The golden rule! Before you close the game or go to sleep, double-check that your character is actively assigned to a gathering node, crafting queue, or combat zone so you never miss out on offline progress.


Keep Your Bags Clean: Inventory space fills up fast when you are offline. Sell, stash, or process your low-level materials frequently so your character doesn't stop looting while you are away.


Focus Your Grind: Idle games are marathons, not sprints. You will progress much faster if you focus on leveling one or two skills at a time rather than trying to upgrade everything at once.


Ask Questions: IdleMMO has a lot of hidden depth. If you aren't sure what gear to equip or where to train next, just drop a question in the guild chat. We are here to help!


Ready to get started?


Hit that join button, grab a spot by the fire, and let's start leveling up together. We're glad to have you!
